title: Endless Dimensions Interwoven
body:
(Mawlana Shaykh stands)
Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar la ilaaha illa-Llah, Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar, wa lillahi 'l-hamd!
Alfu salaat, alfu salaam, thousands and thousands praising and glory on most honored and most beloved one
in His Divine Presence, Sayyidina Muhammad (s). We have been honored to be his nation. O our Lord!
Forgive us, and grant us from Your endless blessings so that we can be good servants for You, for Your
heavenly levels, servants.
(Mawlana Shaykh sits)
As-salaamu `alaykum our listeners through east and west, from north to south. Divinely orders coming to
heavenly orders, and heavenly orders through prophets, messengers, are erreaching on this planet.
Everything in the Divine Presence: ••••••••••••••• ••••• ••••••••••• - laa maqtu`atun wa la mamnu`a - Whose
season is not limited, nor (supply) forbidden, Al-Waqi'a [56:33]
Nothing going to stop and then beginning. Everything from heavenly levels reaching on earth without
stopping, coming never-ending, never-ending, because our Lord's Creation is never-ending. Non-stop. Never

stopping.
And we are calling a support from our master, master of our planet, dunya world, that this planet under his
command is running. Did you see any car without a driver going? Can't be. How is your Lord accepting that
this planet, that we are on it, is moving by itself and directing itself by itself? Impossible. Must be someone
that is sending this planet up to its last limit. Yes, this world just appointed to reach to a limit, but limits
never-ending. Reaching a limit and then starting a new direction appointed through heavenly masters. And
heavenly masters they are using one from holy ones.
Who are holy ones? Holy ones, they are clean ones. If a person not going to be clean, can't be holy one. And
without going to be a master, must be clean also. Because the darajat, stations, never-ending from one to the
second one. That one, that master, must be prepared so that he may get up on another level of heavens.
Heavenly levels, for levels also we are knowing only seven levels, but every level going to open to another
level that can't be known until a person is reaching to that level, and there is not an end or limit to those
heavenly levels. Up and up and up, getting more. Because the Lord of Heavens, He is that One that is giving
and His giving is never-ending. For giving or for granting, Allah Almighty, He likes to grant. Therefore, neverending grants from Allah Almighty to His new creations. Allahu akbar!
O our listeners! Try for an understanding. I know everyone has a level of understanding, but mostly people
are not trying to reach their real level of understanding. Always they are downstairs. Leave that, to be down.
Try to go up, up! Because your Lord's grants are never-ending. Now we are saying for our master, who is
looking after this planet according to holy commands through heavens, making its way on that direction.
How many directions? Countless. We know six directions: right, left, front and back, up and down. But,
according to our levels, you can't be able to bring a number for directions. Now we are living on this planet
through three dimensions. And we think that no fourth dimension? When Einstein was thinking on it, he was
just going to be mad. Can't be able to bring an understanding on it because you are through dimensions. Oh,
and he was looking and understanding a little bit and he was saying, "Why is it only three dimensions? Who
is making them to be in prison through three dimensions?" It is not possible to be a fourth dimension and
after fourth there is five, after five there is six, after six there is seven, after seven there is eight, and after
eight there is nine? And after that there is going to be one and zero.

If reaching a person to that level and looking and seeing, there is only One, and in front of One, all zeroes.
One is only for the Lord of Creation. In front of Him everything is zero! When you are going to be zero, you
are taken to another level, that its dimensions just this and this. (Mawlana Shaykh puts his hands up, with
palms facing his chest, fingertips to fingertips ) Mixing, opposites. Opposite dimensions going to be
appeared. And therefore, our mindly understanding is in limits; perhaps it may be in limits of an atom. You
will look through an atom and you may understand something about that levels. If you are not coming in it,
you are never going to understand anything. Yes, when you are entering an atom's saha - spacious area - that
atom is in it. Atom can't be in a circle surrounding it, but atom is never understanding what or which thing is
covering it and circling it and catching it in its origin.
Therefore, now as long as we are getting up and getting higher from one level to another level, from that level
to another level, our knowledge growing up. First we are looking our real being and we are looking and seeing
that our real being is zero! Zero. But that real being only for that One. Not anyone has a being or real being in
himself, in herself or in itself. No, never! Therefore, when a person is really getting up, is understanding that
there is only One. And when they are looking that One they are understanding that they are zero! Zero. If not
One, there is zero. Also, if that zero is going to be on left side of One it is zero. Nothing. But One in front, zero
is getting a being, appearing as something. But it is zero. One in front of zero makes ten. Two zeroes going to
be 100. Three zeros going to be in front of One, 1000. That zero getting higher and same time understanding
its being not a real being. Coming and opening to that one an understanding, "I am zero but what is this
beings around myself? I know I am zero." (Mawlana turns and asks, "But what is sky fires they are throwing
up") Fireworks. Saying, "I know that I am zero, but same time I am knowing that I have been granted
something. For honor of One, I am granted so many countless values and pleasures and knowledges and
lightenings and so many grants coming to me endlessly. And I am nothing."
That one going to be holy one, not any other one going to be holy. Yes, that holy one must move as holy
commands ordering that one. Therefore, they are not making any mistake. They are always on sirat ul
mustaqeem, right path. Not like this, like that. No. And that is holy one. And the Lord of Heavens He is
ordering to His straight ones, holy ones in His Divine Presence, "Let My servants to be right ones. I am giving
to them from Holy Oceans something, something." No one can know what coming from that Grants Oceans
to holy ones. Holy ones going to be through that oceans, disappearing, and ocean going to be with them and

they are going to be with ocean - not any separation there. No "I am" or "You are." No. Finished! And holy
ones that had been sent from heavens, they are true ones. They are really reaching Holy Oceans beyond our
universe. Beyond, they are saying. Beyond any limit they are coming to us.
Therefore, we are asking from our master a support and also a teaching and also to teach who is hearing.
Who is hearing, taking something. Who not hearing, they are going to be deepest position of creations, rocks.
Rocks and those ones going to be same. No honor. And you are now on a rock. Leave rock and try to arise.
Arise. Arise.
Therefore prophets coming from heavens and their commands coming from heavens. And heavenly
commands making for you a special path for reaching for your special being through that heavenly level.
Allahu akbar! May Allah forgive us.
As-salaamu `alaykum once again! That salaam cleans you and cleans me also and taking from you dirtiness.
Each time you are saying as-salaamu `alaykum that is taking your ugly being, taking from you and you are
going to be seen through heavenly beings so bright, so enlightened, and so praised. SubhanAllah! And now
we are speaking, they are making me to speak such a things to show you the level that you can easily reach.
When you are reaching first level, you are going to be in that level ornaments. Heavenly addressing:
••••••••••• ••••••••• - wa thiyaabaka fathahhir - "And your garments do purify." (74:4), Clean yourelf first to
reach to the first level. And for the second level there is another order to change your clothes and prepare
yourself for the second level. When reaching , another addressing coming, wa thiyaabaka fathahhir. Clean
yourself, be ready for getting up on third level, fourth level, fifth level, sixth level, seventh level. That levels
only we are speaking something on it, but it is impossible without reaching with our real being.
Because no one is reaching to heavens with this physical being; he must come in touch with his heavenly
being. If not heavenly being, you may be like a plane with no motors in it, but only it has a small machine. It
may go up and down on runway, go and come, go and come. But when coming heavenly being to you, then
this power taking you up to second level. And when you are getting enough kamaal, perfection, coming
another power, taking you up to the third level, fourth, fifth, sixth and seventh. Seventh level, that is for
common people's last point; they should reach no more up. Because after this there is some special creation
to pass from that to there, and up through seven levels. Heavenly levels you may move countless directions,

not only four directions or six directions, no. Countless directions!
You can reach on your level east and west, north and south, up and down. Oohhh, countless! Allahu akbar.
You should be enjoyed there. Only for some ones, they have speciality. After seventh there are special beings
that they are carrying reality of being deputies of the Lord of Heavens. If not, never getting up. May Allah
forgive us.
O People! We are saying now a`oodhu billahi min ash-Shaytaani 'r-rajeem. It is time to say this, a`oodhu
billahi min ash-Shaytaani 'r-rajeem because Shaytan asking to make people to come down to darkness
territories, and he is so jealous for Mankind that he never asking anyone for Children of Adam to improve up.
Therefore, he is asking to take them down and down and down and down through darkness territories of
dominions. Allahu akbar. Therefore, O people, we came now to say a`oodhu billahi min ash-Shaytaani 'rrajeem. Remember what you have heard of such a thing and try to understand. And what we are saying, it is
very simple. If we are moving a little bit up, no one can understand. And Shaytan trying to make people to
move through darkness territories of Creation, of dominions. And we may say bismillahi 'r-Rahmaani 'rRaheem. That is the key or that is label written on it, "This one just appointed to reach first level of heavens.
Give way!" Bismillahi 'r-Rahmaani 'r-Raheem. And as long as you are saying bismillahi 'r-Rahmaani 'rRaheem, a new opening for you. Saying the door keeper from angels, "Open, a new one coming. Open for him
the ways of second level of heavens or third, fourth, fifth, sixth or seventh."
Try. At least you may say, "We are listening and we are happy. Even if we are not understanding anything
now, but we like an opening for us to go up, to rise to endless lightening levels of heavens." You should be
granted. May Allah forgive us for the honor of the most honored one.
Dome dome dome dome 4x
O People! For every level of heavens there is an independent territory that never going to be first one. Second
going up. Therefore we are here, saying a kind of music and the praising of angels through heavenly levels.
Ohhh, ohhh SubhanAllah. You are saying, "What you are saying, some kind of nonsense," but people they
are saying it is good for our souls. I know it.
Dome dome dome dome 4x

I like to be for me like David's song, that when he was reciting Psalms mountains was coming and singing
with him. Trees singing with him, birds singing with him - so beautiful sound! And through that levels you
should hear, inshaa-Allah. We may hear, but hear only through a full with dirtiness world what we are saying.
We are saying only Dome dome dome dome 6x
(47 minutes)
Fatihah
(Mawlana shaykh speaks with Shaykh Hisham and Hajjah Naziha via telephone.)
Shaykh Hisham : MashaAllah Mawlana, `ala al-dharra wal-atom wal buhoor.
Sultan Shaykh Nazim: maashaa-Allah barakaatak.
Shaykh Hisham : maa tarakta bahar illa dakhaltu feehi.
Sultan Shaykh Nazim: haadhaa mawlay's power, alhamdulillah.
Shaykh Hisham : haadha mish bahr, haadha fadaa min al-buhoor.
Sultan Shaykh Nazim: Allah Allah. Universe bihaalu.
Shaykh Hisham: Allah ya`ateek al-quwwah.
Sultan Shaykh Nazim: mithla maa taqool yakoon lakum kadhalika
Shaykh Hisham : maraja albahrayni yaltaqiyaani [55:19]. He has made the two seas to flow freely (so that)
they meet together
Sultan Shaykh Nazim: maraj bahr al-wilayah wan-nubuwwah.
Shaykh Hisham: Mawlana, you didn't leave any ocean we didn't enter it. That is not an ocean, that is fada,
universe of oceans.
(325)
